# Aleen Clothing

> Consciously Curated Haute Couture & Heritage Ethnic Fashion

Aleen Clothing is a premier bespoke luxury ethnic fashion atelier specializing in authentic Awadh zardozi needlecraft, pure handloom Banarasi silks, heirloom artisanal Pakistani kurtis, and royal bridal couture.

## Brand Entity & Craft Heritage
- **Atelier Name**: Aleen Clothing (also known as Aleen Atelier)
- **Ethos**: Consciously Curated — heirloom slow fashion, master generational karigars, and ethical handcraftsmanship.
- **Master Needlecrafts**: Authentic Awadh Zardozi, Hand-cut Adda needlework, Gota Patti, Marodi, Dabka, Resham threadwork, and artisanal pearl embellishments.
- **Noble Weaves**: Pure raw silk, Banarasi brocades, handwoven Chanderi, pure organza, tissue drapes, and royal micro-velvet.

## Core Galleries & Collections
- [All Collections Catalog](https://aleen.clothing/collections): Complete curations of royal kurtis, anarkalis, kurta sets, lehengas, and sarees.
- [Pakistani Kurtis & Tunics](https://aleen.clothing/collections?category=kurtis): Pure raw silk and velvet kurtis adorned with Lahore adda needlecraft and hand-cut lace trims.
- [Royal Kurta & Anarkali Sets](https://aleen.clothing/collections?category=kurta-sets): Handloom ensembles accompanied by bespoke trousers and artisanal dupattas.
- [Heritage Sarees & Drapes](https://aleen.clothing/collections?category=sarees): Pure Katan Banarasi weaves, metallic tissue silks, and zardozi borders.
- [Bridal & Bespoke Gowns](https://aleen.clothing/dresses): Architectural couture silhouettes crafted for weddings and gala receptions.
- [Our Craft Story & Atelier](https://aleen.clothing/our-story): Craft provenance, generational karigar profiles, and Awadh heritage narrative.

## Bespoke Services & International Commerce
- **Custom Sizing & Tailoring**: Personalized made-to-measure fittings and custom colorways for global clients.
- **VIP WhatsApp Concierge**: Direct consultations with an atelier private stylist.
- **Worldwide Insured Delivery**: Global express shipping to India, United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Canada, and Europe.
- **Currencies Accepted**: INR (₹), USD ($), AED (د.إ), GBP (£), EUR (€).
